_comment: Canonical model settings. The default is isnet-general-use: 178 MB, fetched once, and the only model here that scores near a commercial cutout. native/profiles.json is a byte-identical copy; harness/parity.mjs fails if they differ. Each family was trained with its own input normalisation, so mean and std are not interchangeable: feeding isnet the ImageNet constants returns a blank mask. protect is how much of a red stroke to ignore where the model is confident it found subject, so a sloppy remove stroke does not gouge the thing you are keeping; 0 makes red literal.

u2netp.note: Small enough to embed. Loses thin low-contrast parts of a subject.

u2net.note: Letterboxing hurts this family badly; it was trained on squashed input.

isnet-general-use.note: Best of the set. 1024 input, so several times slower than u2netp.

silueta.note: u2net architecture at a tenth the size.
